# Productive disagreement · S12

Two editable positions retain proposals, protected benefits, contexts, costs and evidence. Link benefit tokens to context separation, sequencing or a different mechanism; one benefit can inform several alternatives. A link is an intention, not proof. Changed positions flag dependent alternatives for a fresh fit check without erasing reasoning. Develop/fork/select a test while preserving alternatives. Local workspaces, grouped Undo, recovery, Markdown/JSON via creative-kit. Limits: 9 alternatives, 100 workspaces. Tests cover preservation, stale checks, fork independence and selection repair.
